title: Introduce lightweight presubmit JS/TS transform and release-notes sanitizer to reduce CI churn
author: Alex Chen
release_notes: Adds a lightweight JS/TS AST-based transformer that scopes lint/test runs to affected files and a release-notes sanitizer that normalizes changelog entries and strips personal emails. Improves CI feedback loop and reduces presubmit runtime for typical feature branches by ~35%. Includes minor eslint-plugin and devDependency updates.
description: Context: Large monorepo presubmit lanes are a major contributor to slow feedback—full lint/test shards run even for small JS/TS changes. This PR introduces two coordinated changes: 1) a lightweight presubmit JS/TS transform that walks changed file lists, performs a focused AST transform to detect cross-file exports/imports that require wider test/lint scopes, and produces a deterministic file-affinity map so CI lanes only run the necessary shards; 2) a release-notes sanitizer CLI used by the release workflow to normalize entries, remove personal emails, and auto-reformat bullet styling to meet compliance and docs standards. Motivation: reduce developer waiting time, lower CI cost, and prevent leaking email addresses into release artifacts. Summary of changes and rationale: - New tool: tools/presubmit-js-transform/transformer.py (lightweight Python wrapper around esprima for fast parse-and-scan; intentionally minimal external deps). Purpose: compute minimal impacted file set given a git diff and package graph, emit a premerge.affinity file consumed by GH Actions. - New tool: tools/release-sanitizer/sanitize.js (Node script used in release workflows to rewrite release notes; configurable rules via .release-sanitizer.yaml). - CI: workflows/presubmit-light.yml added; this is a staged presubmit lane that runs quick file-affinity computation, then triggers targeted lint/test jobs; old heavy presubmit workflow is gated but still present as nightly fallback. - CI: workflows/release-sanity.yml modified to call release sanitizer before building release artifacts. - Build tooling: package.json updated with devDeps pinned (eslint-plugin-import@2.29.0, eslint@8.46.0) and a small helper script to call the transform in local dev. - Docs: docs/dev/presubmit.md and docs/release/release-notes-guidelines.md updated with usage and troubleshooting. - Tests: unit tests for both tools under tests/presubmit and tests/release-sanitizer; lightweight integration test that runs transform on a sample diff. Commits (high-level): - 3a7b9d5: initial presubmit transformer prototype, tests, and GH Action integration scaffold; - 5b2c1e1: add release-sanitizer, config schema, and formatter rules; - d4f1a7c: CI wiring, update package.json devDeps, small lint fixes; - e9c2b31: address reviewer feedback (improve error handling, adjust affinity heuristic), add docs; - 3a7b9d5efc2a4b8d6f1c9e2a: squash merge commit. Files changed (high level): - tools/presubmit-js-transform/transformer.py (new) - tools/presubmit-js-transform/README.md (new) - tools/release-sanitizer/sanitize.js (new) - .release-sanitizer.yaml.example (new) - workflows/presubmit-light.yml (new) - workflows/release-sanity.yml (modified) - package.json (modified) - docs/dev/presubmit.md (modified) - docs/release/release-notes-guidelines.md (modified) - tests/presubmit/test_affinity_basic.py (new) - tests/release-sanitizer/test_formatting.js (new) - scripts/run_presubmit_local.sh (new small helper) Review conversation summary: - Priya: requested clearer guarantees about false-negatives (i.e., cases where the transformer might under-approximate impacted files). Action: added a conservative fallback path that triggers full presubmit if the transformer encounters ambiguous dynamic imports or unresolvable package.json workspaces; updated README to document the fallback behavior. - Samir: safety suggestion to log the affinity results to build artifacts for 30 days to audit and tune heuristics; implemented as presubmit-affinity.json upload step with redaction of absolute paths. - Evan: asked for pinned devDeps to avoid CI surprises; package.json updated and lockfile refreshed. - Author replies: provided microbenchmarks and a short explainer in the PR body (transform step median runtime 220ms on local dev machine, full pipeline reduction ~35% in average presubmit time across sample runs). CI timeline and status: - Initial run: presubmit-light workflow failed due to a lint rule mismatch (eslint config expects plugin v2.X); author pinned eslint-plugin-import and reran. - Second run: unit tests passed, integration sample produced expected affinity file, release-sanity workflow initially warned about missing .release-sanitizer.yaml in release staging; author added example config and fallback default. - Final run: all checks passed (lint, unit tests, integration sample, GH Action artifact upload). Observability & rollout plan: - This will be enabled behind a feature flag in the presubmit GH Action; default for main is still full presubmit to avoid unexpected regressions. - After monitoring for 2 weeks with affinity logging enabled, plan to flip default to the targeted lane if no regressions in CI and no missed failures in staging. - Add a Canary tag to select repos that have historically had heavy JS changes to accelerate confidence. Backwards compatibility and risk: - No changes to production runtime code. Transformer is presubmit-only and conservative fallback ensures we never undertest when ambiguous. Release-sanitizer performs non-destructive reformatting but strips emails by default (configurable to preserve if a compliance exception is set). Dependency updates are pinned and contained to devDependencies. Post-merge actions performed by author: - Enabled presubmit-light on target repo for the CI testbed and uploaded affinity logs for future tuning. - Created Linear ticket ENG-2240 to evaluate heuristic improvements and gather telemetry. Merge outcome: merged via squash to main after approvals from Priya and Samir and CI green. Notes for reviewers/maintainers: - If you see unexpected test omissions, re-run the full presubmit via the UI or add the skip-affinity label to force full shards. - To extend the sanitizer rules add patterns to .release-sanitizer.yaml and a corresponding test under tests/release-sanitizer. Links: Linear ENG-2145, ENG-2198, ENG-2240; Support SUP-402 for a reported request to remove personal emails from release notes.
